description: This file defines a Data class for managing data caching on DOM elements and other objects within the jQuery library. It includes methods for setting, getting, removing, and checking data associated with objects.

classes.name: Data
classes.description: A class for managing data cache associated with DOM elements and objects.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the cache object for a given owner.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets data on an owner object, either via key-value or properties object.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves data associated with an owner object for a specific key or the entire cache.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Unified method to get or set data depending on provided arguments.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes specified data keys from an owner object.

methods.name: hasData
methods.description: Checks if an owner object has any associated data.
